XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
The electronic control unit is located in the engine compartment.

The diagnostic socket is a standard 16-pin (EOBD) type and is located in the passenger compartment under the dashboard on the driver's side.

The control unit manages all the parameters characteristic of petrol injection, such as the following:

  • Engine speed

  • Engine temperature

  • Battery voltage

  • …………………

    In particular, the following parameters are also highlighted:

    Calculated advance
    Indicates the advance value calculated by the control unit to meet the engine operating conditions.

    Lambda integrator
    This is the correction made by the control unit to the amount of fuel in order to achieve the correct air/fuel ratio.

    Cruise control target speed
    Indicates the speed at which the "CRUISE CONTROL" refers to the cruising speed of the car. The value is only reliable at vehicle speeds above 30 km/h.

The control unit is equipped with permanent error memory and stores the environmental parameters at the moment the error occurs.

They are reported with the attached communication of their status:



Active error
Error is currently detected

Stored error
Error that has already been recorded in memory, and the fault is not currently present.

Error deletion
This only occurs with the operator's consent to delete the error using the delete key

In the Active Diagnostics environment, the following devices are controlled:

Air conditioning compressor
The air conditioning relay is activated for about ten seconds.

Coil 1-2-3-4
The AT coils are controlled separately.

Fuel pump relay
The fuel pump relay is activated.

Injector 1-2-3-4
The injectors are activated individually.

Fan 1st-2nd speed
The fans are activated individually.

Lambda probe heating element 1 upstream and 1 downstream
The heating element inside the lambda probe is activated.

Canister solenoid valve
It is activated for about ten seconds.

Fault indicator control
It is activated for about ten seconds.

VVT (variable valve timing)
When activated, the component should be heard ticking.

The following adjustments can be made:

Starting with code card
Using the vehicle's code card, the engine can be started in the event of a fault with the key or the electronic key control unit/body computer (if present).

Throttle learning storage
The self-learning of the motorised throttle is stored.

Phonic wheel learning reset
To be performed every time the phonic wheel or rev sensor is adjusted
N.B.: First reset the self-adaptive parameters.

Reset self-adaptive parameters
The factory settings are restored in the control unit maps.

Vehicle configuration deletion
Deletes the configuration:

  • Gearbox type
  • Air conditioning type
  • Cruise control
  • ABS
  • Electric drive

    so that the control unit relearns the new configuration.
    N.B.: Only to be performed in the event of configuration errors or in the event of non-virgin control units being installed.

    Resetting camshafts (VVT)
    The data in the control unit relating to the camshafts of the phase variator are reset.
    During the first engine start-up after this reset, the new values are automatically learned.

    N.B.: To be performed when working on the component or replacing the control unit.
